name: Volumetric Representation via Depth Map Registration
definition: Constructs a 3D volume from a set of multi-view images by registering estimated depth maps into a voxel grid. It handles non-Lambertian reflections by using individual minimum cost per view rather than a global threshold, and represents the scene geometry as a sparse voxel cloud where voxel values indicate the number of views mapping to that location.
summary: Volumetric Representation via Depth Map Registration constructs sparse 3D voxel grids from multi-view images, distinguishing itself by handling non-Lambertian reflections and iteratively refining geometry for accurate virtual view synthesis.
